combination.note: The same neutron library with the decay data yani users get by default, ENDF/B-VIII.1. Against the line above this isolates the decay data: it is what moves the Sn, Ta and Ho foils, and where ENDF/B-VIII.1 carries a Q/3 placeholder record (Sn111, Cd105, Co62m) the placeholder is what moves them.
